email.subject: Clearwater Works: mobile visitors can't call you
email.body:
Hi Nora,

I checked Clearwater Works Plumbing's site. Two issues are likely costing you jobs: it doesn't display correctly on mobile, and there's no click-to-call button on phone numbers. Most plumbing searches happen on mobile when someone has a leak right now, and if they can't tap to call in a few seconds, they call the next listing instead.

The site is also slow to load from heavy, unoptimized images, which pushes impatient mobile visitors away before they see your number.

I fix these for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's happening and what it'd take to fix?

Alex
